research_question: Does the frozen 50/50 selected-core plus Stage-A coverage-backfill arm improve broad untouched heldout NLL over equal-budget Stage-A random?

framework_scope.stage_b: chunk-level selected core; no Utility objective
framework_scope.release_training_construction: frozen selected-core plus Stage-A coverage support mixture
framework_scope.utility_scope: Stage C only; never selector objective

target_model.selection_reason: Small permissive base model with public Transformers support; model card describes it as a pretraining-stage causal LM suitable for continued pretraining.

excluded_from_confirmatory_success_count.reason: The 50/50 candidate was created after observing the seed-20260608 selected-only full-budget reversal.

primary.name: confirmatory_broad_stageA_eval
primary.role: Only this evaluation determines primary success.

secondary.name: confirmatory_coverage_stratified_stageA_eval
secondary.role: Mechanism diagnostic; cannot rescue primary failure.

required: backfilled mean NLL is lower than Stage-A random mean NLL on the primary holdout across the two fresh confirmatory seeds
backfilled NLL is lower than Stage-A random NLL on both fresh confirmatory seeds
no missing or NaN primary outcomes
training recipe and frozen files match this plan
primary_success_rule.failure_rule: Any required condition failure means the frozen 50/50 confirmatory direction is not supported.
primary_success_rule.secondary_evaluation_rule: Secondary outcomes are reported but cannot change primary pass/fail.
primary_success_rule.statistical_boundary: Two fresh seeds provide directional replication, not a final high-power confidence-interval claim.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_successful: Scoped confirmatory evidence that the frozen 50/50 coverage-backfilled release arm improves internal broad heldout NLL over equal-budget Stage-A random for this FineWeb-Edu/Qwen setup.
not_allowed: Claiming that 50/50 is optimal or universal
Deployment-ready claim without external benchmark, forgetting, safety, and contamination checks
Using target-SLM outcomes as a Stage-B selector objective
